text:
oliver: Quick kickoff idea for the next PLG push — "Starter Velocity" funnel. core: 1) 25 starter credits, 2) 3-curated prompt pack (embed/gen/rewrite), 3) 20-min on-demand demo + live q&a. objective: increase first-success within 24h and reduce time-to-value.
maria: solid. couple asks: short window (48h), microcopy showing expiry, and a tiny gif demo for embed lane.
ashley: creative lanes: 'prototype' (code) vs 'publish' (marketing). We'll A/B subject lines and CTA phrasing.
zack: segmentation: pick lane from signup 'primary_use' or fallback to behavioural routing (if they hit playground embed doc -> embed lane).
sam: ops note: throttle new accounts 80rpm, credits auto-expire in 7d, gate to signups only. can create experiment flag starter_velocity_v1.
oliver: proposed cadence: 0h email + credits + CTA, 6h in-app nudge w/ 1-click prompt pack, 18h reminder + webinar invite, 48h last-chance. compress to 48h.
maria: metrics: activation = first_success, target = 35% within 24h, cost target <$0.65 per activation. track cost by model_name + variant.
ashley: subject options: "25 credits to try Redwood in minutes" vs "Try these 3 prompts  see an instant result". A/B top 2.
zack: routing rules: default -> cost-optimized-gen, embed_flag -> small-embeds, fallback -> standard-hosted-gen. log model_name for every prompt_executed event.
sam: rollout plan: soft-launch Fri 9am PT at 8% traffic. ramp to 40% if no regressions in 48h. alerts: pause if first_success <25% or cost/activation > $1.
maria: prompt-pack constraints: 3 prompts max, each with a 'seed input' example and a one-line expected outcome. store as PromptPack/starter_v1 (immutable).
oliver: growth-bot: experiment created starter_velocity_v1 id: exp_20260803_6. traffic: 8% initial; auto-ramp rules set.
ashley: deliverables: email A/B, in-app copy, 20s embed gif, 3 prompt texts + seed inputs. deadline: Wed EOD.
sam: infra checklist: create flag, quotas, event hooks (credits_granted, prompt_pack_opened, prompt_executed, first_success, webinar_registered), add alert for avg latency >2s.
maria: runbook essentials: 1) how to pause credits (flag), 2) rollback steps, 3) eng-runtime oncall contact. i'll own orchestration + metrics.
zack: UX suggestion: show a small countdown in product header for new signups when credits are active. increases conversion.
ashley: noted, will mock.
oliver: great. timeline: drafts by Wed, infra ready Thu morning, soft launch Fri 9am PT. will drop prompt drafts here for quick review. keep replies short.
